events.name: Crosswind
events.announce: A crosswind kicks up across {stadium}.
events.effectText: The crosswind holds it up! What should have been a flyout drops for a double.

events.name: Headwind
events.announce: The flags snap straight in. Wind blowing in.
events.effectText: The wind knocks it down! That was a home run anywhere else. Caught at the wall.

events.name: Tailwind
events.announce: Wind blowing out at {stadium}. Pitchers hate this.
events.effectText: The tailwind grabs it and carries it out! A routine fly becomes a home run.

events.name: Sea Fog
events.announce: Fog rolls in off the water. Fielders squint.
events.effectText: Lost in the fog! {f} never sees it, and {b} is safe.

events.name: Rogue Wave
events.announce: The tide is unusually high tonight.
events.effectText: A rogue wave washes over the basepaths and carries {r} off the field! {r} is out.

events.name: Seagull Swarm
events.announce: Seagulls are circling the outfield.
events.effectText: A seagull intercepts the ball! It's ruled a catch. Nobody argues with the gull.

events.name: The Whispering
events.announce: A whisper drifts through {stadium}. The pitchers hear it most.
events.effectText: {p} hears the whisper mid-delivery and flinches. Ball.

events.name: Cold Spot
events.announce: A cold spot settles over the infield.
events.effectText: The ball hits the cold spot and dies. What should have been extra bases is just a single.

events.name: Phantom Runner
events.announce: Someone is standing on third base. Nobody sent them.
events.effectText: The phantom runner scores, and the umpire counts it. {t} get a run from beyond.

events.name: Dugout Moans
events.announce: Moaning from the visitors' dugout.
events.effectText: The moaning gets to {p}. Wild pitch, runners advance.

events.name: Ash Fall
events.announce: Ash begins drifting onto the field.
events.effectText: {f} slips on the ash! {b} reaches on the error.

events.name: Thermal Updraft
events.announce: Heat rises off the lava moat in shimmering waves.
events.effectText: The updraft lifts it! A double turns into a triple.

events.name: Minor Eruption
events.announce: The ground rumbles under {stadium}.
events.effectText: A small eruption! Everybody runs, and every runner moves up a base.

events.name: Lava Bounce
events.announce: The infield dirt is getting suspiciously warm.
events.effectText: The ball bounces off a hot patch and skips past {f}. Single!

events.name: Star Alignment
events.announce: The stars align over {stadium}. Literally.
events.effectText: The stars approve. The hit grows by one base.

events.name: Gravity Flicker
events.announce: Gravity at {stadium} is behaving oddly.
events.effectText: Gravity flickers! The popup keeps going up. And up. Home run?! Home run.

events.name: Time Skip
events.announce: The scoreboard clock runs backward for a moment.
events.effectText: Time skips, and the scoreboard insists {t} scored a run that nobody saw.

events.name: Eclipse
events.announce: The sky goes dark. An eclipse at {stadium}.
events.effectText: {b} can't see a thing in the eclipse. Strike.

events.name: Blood Moon Howl
events.announce: The blood moon rises. Something howls.
events.effectText: The blood moon's light makes the ball fly further. Extra base!

events.name: Mosquito Cloud
events.announce: A cloud of mosquitoes settles around the mound.
events.effectText: {p} swats at a mosquito mid-pitch. Ball.

events.name: Soft Bog
events.announce: The infield is soft and sinking tonight.
events.effectText: The ball plugs in the bog. {f} picks it out and throws {b} out.

events.name: Frog Chorus
events.announce: The frogs start singing.
events.effectText: Distracted by the frogs, {r} wanders off base. Picked off!

events.name: Ice Patch
events.announce: Frost is forming on the basepaths.
events.effectText: {f} hits the ice and goes down! {b} is safe on the error.

events.name: Numb Hands
events.announce: Brutal cold tonight. Bats sting.
events.effectText: {b}'s hands go numb on contact. That should've been more. Just a single.

events.name: Snow Squall
events.announce: A snow squall blows across the outfield.
events.effectText: The ball vanishes into the squall and lands untouched. Single!

events.name: Heat Shimmer
events.announce: Heat shimmer bends the air at {stadium}.
events.effectText: The pitch wobbles in the shimmer. {b} swings at a ghost. Strike.

events.name: Dust Devil
events.announce: A dust devil spins up near second base.
events.effectText: The dust devil grabs the ball and spits it into the gap! Double!

events.name: Mirage
events.announce: There appear to be two of every outfielder.
events.effectText: {f} catches it, or the mirage of {f} does. Out either way.

events.name: Funnel Cloud
events.announce: A funnel cloud touches down beyond the outfield.
events.effectText: The tornado drags everyone one base forward!

events.name: Crowd Surge
events.announce: The crowd at {stadium} is roaring.
events.effectText: The crowd noise rattles {f}, who hesitates. The hit stretches an extra base.

events.name: Ceiling Ricochet
events.announce: The roof seems lower than yesterday.
events.effectText: It hits the ceiling and drops! A home run anywhere else becomes a popout.

events.name: Slope Roll
events.announce: The sloped outfield is extra slippery today.
events.effectText: The ball rolls downhill forever. That's an extra base.
